intro: A reusable credit card for health, dental and wellness. Promotional financing on purchases of $200 or more, and you can use it again for future care.

site.label: Check your options with CareCredit →
site.note: Soft credit check. Does not affect your score.

facts.sub: No-interest promotional periods if paid in full
Use it again for future dental care

steps.t: Apply online or by phone and get a decision in minutes
Choose a promotional plan that fits your estimate
Pay CareCredit monthly. Pay in full within the promo period to avoid interest

faq.a: Yes, if you pay the full balance within the promotional period. Interest is charged from the purchase date if you do not.

faq.q: Can I use CareCredit for both visits?
faq.a: Yes. It is a revolving card, so it covers your whole treatment and future visits.

faq.q: What credit score do I need?
faq.a: CareCredit does not publish a minimum. Our coordinator can help you compare with Cherry or Sunbit if you are not approved.

disclaimer: CareCredit is a third-party lender. Financing is subject to credit approval. Terms and rates are set by CareCredit and may change. Xiluet does not make credit decisions.
